title: Two Powers Become One/Quotes
summary:
"This temple is controlled by the Organization - and you have just walked into your tomb." (Unnamed Suit 012 to Dante Vale) 

"If this giant place is a tomb just for Dante, you're gonna have to build a few more for the rest of us." (Lok Lambert to Unnamed Suit 012)

"Yeah, sure... Oh wait, got a museum lecture on Thursday. I can't." 
 - Montehue to Dante Vale, after they are told to surrender by Unnamed Suit 012

"It's cool being a Seeker. You explore strange new cultures and get attacked by them."
 - Lok Lambert to the team after being attacked by the Guardians of Thor

"Freeze me? Oh no, I'm just warming up!"
- Montehue to Unnamed Suit 012 after Unnamed Suit 012 had invoked Jokoul 

"It's nice fighting side by side, Dante, but we're still in competition. I'm bringing Mjolnir back and don't you forget it." 
 - Montehue to Dante Vale

"Life and death situations are good for the heart." 
 - Montehue to Lok Lambert  

"Oh my goodness! Out of the frying pan and into the fire!" 
 - Tersly to Dante Vale

"Don't eat me, please!" 
 - Tersly to Fenris

"I'm sending you to the pound... on a leash!" 
 - Dante Vale to Fenris before tying it with Gleipnir

"I'm a Seeker, not a dog catcher."
 - Zhalia Moon to the team while tying Fenris with Gleipnir

"That won't hold them back long, even though they're only as strong as a litter of kittens."
 - Montehue to Zhalia Moon while attempting to hold back the Guardians of Thor

"That thing looks like it's almost as heavy as my Western Civ textbook. Can we give you a hand?"
 - Lok Lambert to Montehue about Mjolnir

"A Titan bonds most easily with a Seeker close in spirit to its original user. And the closest to the spirit of Thor is you."
 - Dante Vale to Montehue about Fenris
